question: Should OpenClaw accept this CLI catalog as a core public CLI/plugin/prompt surface now, split it into narrower reviewable layers, or keep it as an RFC/prototype for later?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds new user-facing commands, plugin descriptor fields, generated docs, audit/report scripts, and prompt behavior; code review cannot choose that product/API boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split And Review Direction First
options.body: Keep the draft open but ask for a staged plan that separates the stable CLI read path from plugin API and prompt changes before merge.

options.title: Accept As Experimental Core Surface
options.body: Maintainership can explicitly sponsor the broad surface and require compatibility docs, live proof, and conflict resolution before landing.

options.title: Pause Or Close The Prototype
options.body: If this catalog is not desired in core now, close or pause the branch and keep discussion in the linked RFC until a maintainer sponsors it.

recommendation.title: Split And Review Direction First
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open but ask for a staged plan that separates the stable CLI read path from plugin API and prompt changes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties this person to the central CLI/plugin/prompt paths touched by the proposed catalog surface.
